queries: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_average FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_average FROM country_averages), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ca.country_average > b.overall_average), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS second_average FROM above_benchmark) SELECT a.country, a.country_average, a.country_average - b.overall_average AS above_overall_benchmark, a.country_average - s.second_average AS above_second_mean FROM above_benchmark AS a CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE a.country_average > s.second_average
